column4: dialect-gated per SUBTEST: a registeredBackends test, so it runs one subtest per dialect. In this job's environment only PostgreSQL is set, so that dialect's subtest RUNS and the other two skip -- two, not three. Measured by name, not by delta, in this job's own environment (CLEAT_TEST_DB only): go test ./engine/ -run TestEveryRunIdAStoreGeneratesIsACanonicalLowercaseUUID$ -count=1 -json | grep '"Action":"skip"' reports exactly these two. Guards cleat#3639: every run id a store generates is a canonical lowercase UUID, asserted on the stored row.
